restaurant.name: Moka
restaurant.tagline: A neighbourhood cafe for good coffee, fresh bakes, and slow mornings

hero.description: a neighbourhood cafe for good coffee, fresh food, days that start solo, get social, take a detour, and somehow end with you still here.

stickyDeck.heading: coffee when you need it,
stickyDeck.subheading: food when you're hungry, plus somewhere nice to be while the day figures itself out.
stickyDeck.body: we roast in small batches, bake every morning at 5am, and leave plenty of time for unhurried conversations.

stickyDeck.heading: careful roasting, fresh grinds,
stickyDeck.subheading: coffee people will get it. everyone else gets really good coffee.
stickyDeck.body: directly sourced from independent high-altitude washing stations across colombia, ethiopia, and guatemala.

stickyDeck.heading: menus change. new things land.
stickyDeck.subheading: some things disappear quickly. this is where we keep track of what's currently happening.
stickyDeck.body: classic cold coffees, nitro cocoa infusions, and warm double-laminated butter croissants.

stickyDeck.heading: name a better duo.
stickyDeck.subheading: steaming cappuccino + warm morning butter croissant.
stickyDeck.body: flaky, buttery layers fresh out of the deck oven paired with rich double-ristretto steamed milk foam.

stickyMenu.sideTitle: first sips, flaky layers, cravings, buttery crumbs
stickyMenu.sideDescription: all espresso shots pulled on our synesso mvp. oat, almond, and whole milk options available. baked fresh every single morning.
